releaseNotes:
v6.6.0 — Mandatory Performance & Stability Update

• Correct Playlist Titles: Fixed online playlists and albums showing generic title instead of their actual name.
• App Notification Branding: Notification player now features official Raazi icon.
• Instant Lyrics Caching: Lyrics load instantaneously for previously played songs without re-fetching.
• Library Controls: Added 'Don't show again' option to dismiss YouTube Music sign-in prompt permanently.
• Micro Player & UI Settings: Enhanced micro player gestures, animations, and controls.
